removeMember.title: Remove from workspace
removeMember.description: The member's access to this workspace ends. Their account stays: their personal space and other workspaces are not affected.
removeMember.previewFailed: The consequences could not be calculated. Removal is only possible after you have seen them.
removeMember.heir: Their work is handed over to: {name}.
removeMember.noHeir: No member was found to take over their work.
removeMember.actTeams: {count, plural, =0 {They are not responsible for any action team.} one {Responsibility for # action team is handed over.} other {Responsibility for # action teams is handed over.}}
removeMember.signsOut: This workspace is their home workspace: they will be signed out of all their devices.
removeMember.staysSignedIn: They stay signed in — they only lose access to this workspace.
removeMember.notified: They will be notified of the removal.
removeMember.reasonPlaceholder: Recorded in the audit log and in the notification.
removeMember.success: The member was removed from the workspace.
removeMember.error: The removal did not complete. Try again — retrying is safe.

refused.notAMember: They are no longer a member of this workspace.
refused.selfRemoval: You cannot remove yourself from the workspace.
refused.notSelfDeparture: Leaving can only be done by the user themselves.
refused.outranksActor: They hold a higher role than yours — you cannot change their access.
refused.lastManager: They are the last administrator of this workspace. Assign another administrator first.
refused.selfPause: You cannot pause your own access.
refused.selfRestore: You cannot restore your own access.

pauseAccess.title: Pause access to the workspace
pauseAccess.description: The member stays in the workspace with their role, but cannot open it until you restore access. Their personal space and other workspaces are not affected.
pauseAccess.staysMember: They remain a member — role, teams and history stay as they are.
pauseAccess.actTeamsKept: {count, plural, =0 {They are not responsible for any action team.} one {They are responsible for # action team — it will have no available owner while the pause lasts.} other {They are responsible for # action teams — they will have no available owner while the pause lasts.}}
pauseAccess.notified: They will be notified of the pause.
pauseAccess.error: The pause did not complete. Try again — retrying is safe.

restoreAccess.title: Restore access to the workspace
restoreAccess.description: The member can open the workspace again immediately, with the same role — no new invitation, and they are not signed out anywhere.
restoreAccess.notified: They will be notified that access was restored.
restoreAccess.error: The restore did not complete. Try again — retrying is safe.
